notes.title: #41: The New Demo is Here – Experience the First Chapter
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome Back, Dear Followers of [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i]![/h3][p]We’re beyond excited to share another major milestone with all of you who have been faithfully following the journey of [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i]. Thank you for being part of this story - your support continues to mean the world to us! [/p][h3]Goodbye Old Prologue, Hello New Demo![/h3][p]
After a very promising round of internal playtests, we’ve made the decision to [b]retire the outdated prologue[/b] created by the former development team. It no longer reflects the direction and quality we’re striving for.[/p][p]Instead, we now invite you to experience [b]something truly new[/b] - a fresh take on the vision of [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i], built from the ground up by our current team.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Demo is Live - Play it Now![/h3][p]The wait is over - the [b]official demo is available right now[/b]! Just head over to our Steam page and [b]click the big green “Download” button[/b] to jump into the experience. We can't wait to hear what you think![/p][p][/p][h3]Share Your Thoughts - We’re Listening[/h3][p]We deeply value your feedback. Whether it’s a bug, a thought, or an idea, we want to hear it all. You can share your impressions [b]on the Steam forums[/b] or [b]reach out directly via email[/b] - every message will be read and considered by our team.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s Next? Even More Improvements Ahead![/h3][p]Thanks to your participation in the recent playtests, we’ve already made tons of improvements and we’re not stopping there. In the [b]next wave of playtesting[/b], you can expect:[/p][list][*][p]A more intense and enriched [b]encounter between Jesus and Satan[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Dialogue improvements[/b] aligned more closely with source material[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]quests and objectives[/b][/p][/*][*][p]And [b]much, much more[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]We’re building something special together. Thank you for walking this path with us and as always, see you in the game![/p][p]The [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: #40: Upcoming Demo and Playtest rounds!
notes.notes: [p]We’re thrilled to welcome you back with a fresh announcement about [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i]! Thank you for sticking with us and following the development of the game — we’ve got some exciting updates to share with you.[/p][p][/p][h2]A Lot Has Changed Since Our Last Update[/h2][p]Since our previous announcement, we’ve made [b]tremendous progress[/b]. Countless hours of work have gone into improving and expanding the game. Many systems have been rewritten from the ground up when compared to the "Prologue" version, bugs have been fixed, and both the visual and gameplay experience have been significantly enhanced. For those of you familiar with earlier builds — this is truly a [b]new and transformed version[/b] of the game.[/p][p][/p][h2]Playtests Are Ongoing – Returning Testers Are Welcome![/h2][p]We're currently in the middle of [b]active playtesting[/b]. If you received access to the previous version of the game developed by the former team back in 2023— [b]you are also invited to join the new playtests[/b]! The link to download the new version should work for you again! We warmly welcome your return, and we’d love to hear your impressions of this updated experience.[/p][p][/p][h2]Haven’t Got Access Yet? Hang Tight![/h2][p]If you haven’t received access to the playtest yet — [b]please bear with us[/b]. We're steadily fixing issues and releasing test access in batches to ensure stability and quality for everyone involved. Thank you for your patience and support — it's hugely appreciated.[/p][p][/p][h2]Wishlist the Upcoming Demo – Release Date Now Set![/h2][p]We’re excited to announce that the [b]official public demo[/b] of [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i] will be available starting [b]July 24th[/b]! You can already [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] using the link below so you don't miss the release:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2007580/I_Am_Jesus_Christ_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Adding the game to your wishlist truly helps us — thank you for your support![/p][p][/p][h2]Thanks for All Your Bug Reports![/h2][p]Finally, we want to sincerely thank everyone who’s been reporting bugs and issues. We read every single one, and all of your feedback is being taken seriously as we polish the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for being part of this journey. We’re getting closer to release, and we couldn’t do it without you. Stay tuned — and see you in the game![/p][p]— The [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #39: Playtests round
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, and Happy New Year!

We’re hard at work on [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i], and we’re excited to invite you to the next round of [b]Steam Playtests[/b]. This time, you’ll get to experience a version of the game built entirely by our new team. To join the queue and be ready to download the demo as soon as it’s available, simply click the button "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1198970/I_Am_Jesus_Christ/]Request Access[/url]" on the game’s main Steam page.

In addition to playing, we would greatly appreciate your feedback through a survey included with the demo. Your answers will help us refine the experience and deliver a game that meets your expectations.

Lastly, here’s a glimpse of what we’ve been working on:

Character dialogues inspired by the Gospels, adapted for the interactive medium:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/7306cab69044f933f60c4c3b86b79c99eb071bef.jpg[/img]

Cinematic cutscenes highlighting key moments of the story:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/385f59e504c9bcaf6df66ea2ffed06dee53d8bc4.jpg[/img]

Populated towns and cities to bring realism and immerse players in the world of Galilee and Jerusalem as they appeared in Jesus’ time:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/a8b2a79d26c4e801ea2dfa0a8ff1c50dd9ed12b5.jpg[/img]


Thank you for your support! Stay tuned for more updates as we continue this journey together.

notes.title: Devlog #38: Open World
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It’s been a while since our last update, but we’re back in full force, more committed than ever to advancing the development of [b]I Am Jesus Christ[/b]!

The break was due to a restructuring of our team earlier this year, which we believe has ultimately benefited the project. We've learned lessons from the years of work by the previous team and, most importantly, from your feedback on the Prologue. Having that in mind, we’re directing our focus towards the most anticipated areas of improvement for [b]I Am Jesus Christ[/b]. First up, we’re excited to introduce the game’s biggest design change:

[h2]Open World Exploration[/h2]

Until now, the Prologue’s events unfolded within limited spaces, constrained by both natural elements and invisible boundaries. To deepen the immersion and provide a sense of the environment in Jesus’ time, we’ve decided to open up the world. You will now be able to explore the regions of Galilee, Samaria, and Judea—covering nearly the entire journey of Christ’s ministry.

[h3]Nazareth and Surroundings[/h3]
Experience the town where Jesus lived with His family, where He learned His craft, connected with the people, and, after certain events, narrowly escaped being executed. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/b976b83a6d4b376564c8eec9d63ecd124cd4b23b.gif[/img]

[h3]The Sea of Galilee[/h3]
Visit numerous historical locations along the shore and witness the miracles of Christ from a first-person perspective, reliving these incredible events up close. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/2706f2ae6e803d4a0beed0509766cceb3cd203cf.gif[/img]

[h3]The Judean Desert[/h3]
Encounter the rugged wilderness of Samaria and feel the vastness of the open landscape. Endure the 40-day fast and discover the banks of the Jordan River, where you’ll experience Christ’s baptism by John the Baptist. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/fd0c739c8b1e0097e2dcd34c2341d71ef1f28131.gif[/img]

[h3]The City of Jerusalem[/h3]
Immerse yourself in the bustling life of the largest historical city in the region. Explore its narrow streets in the heart of the city and see the most iconic locations around its ancient walls. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/35061bf0e1954ff6db676939dda8ae8cc75bf22b.gif[/img]

[h3]Other Well-Known Biblical Sites[/h3]
Take a journey to the other famous locations recreated from historical maps, engravings, and records, such as Mount Tabor, Cana, Nain, Sychar, and Bethany. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/009d15b60b3b8f48bd49b2e7105cad0595374a7d.gif[/img]

Stay tuned here on Steam for more updates as we reveal further details about the project in the coming weeks. We can’t wait to share what’s next with you!

notes.title: IGN Festival 2023: "I Am Jesus Christ" Game to be Featured!
notes.notes:
Hi
We are thrilled to announce that "I Am Jesus Christ" has been selected to be presented at the upcoming IGN Festival 2023! This is a huge honor for our team, and we're excited to share our game with the world.

The festival will take place on February 17th and 18th, and our presentation is scheduled for 10am PT / 1pm ET. So be sure to tune in and catch all the action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/4e6a97277aacaefd3ee3f8fdb9533bdf8c9a3941.jpg[/img]

We can't wait to share our game with you, and we're sure that you'll love it as much as we do. With its unique and innovative take on the story of Jesus Christ, "I Am Jesus Christ" is a game like no other. So be sure to mark your calendars and tune in to the IGN Festival 2023 to see what we have in store for you!

Best regards,
The "I Am Jesus Christ" Team

notes.notes:
Hi
and we are really super excited to announce that finally Prologue version of I Am Jesus Christ is LIVE!
Yes, all of us will have the upcoming holiday season. For that reason, we are happy to present such a present to our community with this free Prologue.

What will you find in it?
1. Over 1 hour of gameplay 
2. Gameplay mode for experienced players and Story Mode for new ones in the gaming space.
